description: This file contains source code for patching and configuring Realtek RTL8261N/RTL826XB PHY devices in a Linux environment. It includes functions for reading and writing PHY registers, waiting for certain hardware states, and applying patches or configuration sequences specific to different PHY models or modes. The code also provides mechanisms for initializing patch tables and applying patches to individual PHY ports, supporting both per-port and per-chip broadcast modes.
